description: This Java interface defines configuration settings for the HTTP behavior of the Gateway service, including supported schema versions, HTTPS enforcement, CORS, request timeout, header definitions, media types, and related configuration values.

classes.name: HttpConfig
classes.description: Interface providing configuration settings for the Gateway service's HTTP behavior.

classes.name: HttpConfig.GatewayHttpConfigValue
classes.description: Enumeration of known configuration path expressions and default values for HttpConfig.

methods.name: getSupportedSchemaVersions
methods.description: Returns the set of schema versions supported by the API Gateway.

methods.name: isForceHttps
methods.description: Indicates whether HTTPS enforcement is enabled.

methods.name: isRedirectToHttps
methods.description: Indicates whether redirection to HTTPS is enabled.

methods.name: getRedirectToHttpsBlocklistPattern
methods.description: Returns the pattern for paths that should not be redirected to HTTPS.

methods.name: getRequestTimeout
methods.description: Returns the timeout duration for HTTP requests.

methods.name: getActorPropsFactoryFullQualifiedClassname
methods.description: Returns the class name for the HttpRequestActorPropsFactory implementation.

methods.name: getQueryParametersAsHeaders
methods.description: Returns header definitions derived from query parameters.

methods.name: getAdditionalAcceptedMediaTypes
methods.description: Returns additional media types accepted by endpoints.
